services.value: Provides environmental testing services including water quality and soil analysis, hazardous materials assessment, and testing for core competencies such as stormwater (Table 915-1, 915B), soil suitability (table 3-1), produced water, PFAS water, and analyses for VOCs/SVOCs, metals, and TPH using instruments including GC/MS, GC/FID, ICPMS, and LC/MS/MS.
